caption_L1: This is a line graph titled Botswana : Distribution of gross domestic product (GDP) across economic sectors from 2009 to 2019. On the x-axis, Year is plotted. A linear scale from 0.0 to 0.4 can be found on the y-axis, labeled Industry.
caption_L2L3: The Graph tells me that Botswana's GDP has been gradually falling over the years, with peaks mostly in 2014 and 2016 before falling again to the previous low in the odd years, with 2012 being the exception. I also noticed that 2009 and 2019 have the same GDP growth placed at 0.29. Over the 10 year period it seems that Botswana has grown very little and has grown the exact same in the years 2009 and 2019.
